name: pit-stop
description: Keeps subagents small: tells the main agent how to size and split work, asks a growing subagent to checkpoint, and refuses its tools past a hard limit so a fresh agent takes over

nudgeAtK.title: Ask to checkpoint at (thousand tokens)
nudgeAtK.description: When a subagent's requests carry this much context, ask it to finish its current item, write a handoff note and stop.

stopAtK.title: Refuse tools at (thousand tokens)
stopAtK.description: Past this much context a subagent gets a few tool calls to checkpoint, then every tool call is refused. Always at least 50 above the checkpoint setting.
